mapper.select: select o.order_no as orderNo, date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, o.member_name as memberName, case o.order_type when 1 then '门店收银' when 2 then '线上下单' else '教材预订' end as orderType, o.total_amount as totalAmount, o.discount_total as discountTotal, o.pay_amount as payAmount, case o.status when 1 then '待支付' when 2 then '已支付' when 3 then '待取货' when 4 then '已完成' when 5 then '已取消' when 6 then '退款中' else '已退款' end as status, o.cashier_by as cashierBy, coalesce((select sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty) from biz_order_item oi where oi.order_id = o.order_id), 0) as grossProfit from biz_order o where o.store_id = 1 and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) order by o.order_id

select b.book_no as bookNo, b.isbn, b.title, coalesce(c.category_name, '未分类') as categoryName, coalesce(sum(s.qty_available), 0) as qtyAvailable, coalesce(sum(s.qty_locked), 0) as qtyLocked, coalesce(sum(s.qty_borrowed), 0) as qtyBorrowed, coalesce(sum(s.qty_damaged), 0) as qtyDamaged, coalesce(sum((s.qty_available + s.qty_locked + s.qty_damaged) * b.cost_price), 0) as totalAmount from biz_stock s join biz_book b on b.book_id = s.book_id left join biz_category c on c.category_id = b.category_id where s.store_id = 1 and b.category_id = #{categoryId} group by b.book_no, b.isbn, b.title, c.category_name order by b.book_no

select m.member_no as memberNo, m.nickname, m.phone, coalesce(ms.student_no, '') as studentNo, m.level_name as levelName, m.points, m.balance_principal as balancePrincipal, m.balance_gift as balanceGift, m.deposit_balance as depositBalance, case m.status when 1 then '正常' when 2 then '冻结' when 3 then '黑名单' else '已注销' end as status, date_format(m.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from biz_member m left join biz_member_student ms on ms.member_id = m.member_id where m.store_id = 1 order by m.member_id

select 'profile' as recordType, m.member_no as bizNo, m.nickname as title, 0 as qty, null as amount, null as pointChange, m.status as status, m.register_time as eventTime from biz_member m where m.member_id = #{memberId} union all select 'order' as recordType, o.order_no as bizNo, concat('订单-', o.status) as title, o.total_qty as qty, o.pay_amount as amount, null as pointChange, o.status as status, coalesce(o.finish_time, o.pay_time, o.create_time) as eventTime from biz_order o where o.member_id = #{memberId} union all select 'borrow' as recordType, b.borrow_no as bizNo, b.title, 1 as qty, null as amount, null as pointChange, b.status as status, coalesce(b.return_time, b.borrow_time) as eventTime from biz_borrow b where b.member_id = #{memberId} union all select 'point' as recordType, p.ref_no as bizNo, p.remark as title, 0 as qty, null as amount, p.points_change as pointChange, null as status, p.create_time as eventTime from biz_point_log p where p.member_id = #{memberId} order by eventTime desc

select borrow_no as borrowNo, member_no as memberNo, member_name as memberName, isbn, title, date_format(borrow_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as borrowTime, date_format(due_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as dueTime, date_format(return_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as returnTime, case status when 1 then '在借' when 2 then '已归还' when 3 then '已逾期' else '已赔偿' end as status, fine_amount as fineAmount, operator_by as operatorBy from biz_borrow where store_id = 1 and borrow_time >= #{start} and borrow_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) order by borrow_id

select c.check_no as checkNo, case c.check_type when 1 then '全盘' else '抽盘' end as checkType, i.isbn, i.title, i.book_qty as bookQty, i.actual_qty as actualQty, i.diff_qty as diffQty, i.diff_amount as diffAmount, case i.diff_type when 1 then '盘盈' when 2 then '盘亏' when 3 then '盘点期差异' else '无差异' end as diffType, i.reason, date_format(i.check_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as checkTime from biz_stock_check_item i join biz_stock_check c on c.check_id = i.check_id where c.store_id = 1 and i.diff_qty <> 0 and i.check_time >= #{start} and i.check_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) order by i.item_id

choose.when: select date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dimensionKey, date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dimensionName, coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) as saleAmount, count(distinct o.order_id) as orderCount, coalesce(sum((select coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty), 0) from biz_order_item oi where oi.order_id = o.order_id)), 0) as grossProfit, coalesce(sum(o.discount_total), 0) as discountTotal, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 7 then o.pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as refundAmount from biz_order o where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by dimensionKey limit #{limit}

select cast(coalesce(c.category_id, 0) as char) as dimensionKey, coalesce(c.category_name, '未分类') as dimensionName, coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount), 0) as saleAmount, count(distinct o.order_id) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty), 0) as grossProfit, 0 as discountTotal, 0 as refundAmount from biz_order o join biz_order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.order_id left join biz_book b on b.book_id = oi.book_id left join biz_category c on c.category_id = b.category_id where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by c.category_id, c.category_name order by saleAmount desc limit #{limit}

select cast(o.member_level_id as char) as dimensionKey, coalesce(ml.level_name, '散客/未知') as dimensionName, coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) as saleAmount, count(distinct o.order_id) as orderCount, coalesce(sum((select coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty), 0) from biz_order_item oi where oi.order_id = o.order_id)), 0) as grossProfit, coalesce(sum(o.discount_total), 0) as discountTotal, 0 as refundAmount from biz_order o left join biz_member_level ml on ml.level_id = o.member_level_id where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by o.member_level_id, ml.level_name order by saleAmount desc limit #{limit}

select cast(o.order_type as char) as dimensionKey, case o.order_type when 1 then '门店收银' when 2 then '线上下单' else '教材预订' end as dimensionName, coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) as saleAmount, count(distinct o.order_id) as orderCount, coalesce(sum((select coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty), 0) from biz_order_item oi where oi.order_id = o.order_id)), 0) as grossProfit, coalesce(sum(o.discount_total), 0) as discountTotal, 0 as refundAmount from biz_order o where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by o.order_type order by saleAmount desc limit #{limit}

select o.cashier_by as dimensionKey, case when o.cashier_by = '' then '未记录' else o.cashier_by end as dimensionName, coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) as saleAmount, count(distinct o.order_id) as orderCount, coalesce(sum((select coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty), 0) from biz_order_item oi where oi.order_id = o.order_id)), 0) as grossProfit, coalesce(sum(o.discount_total), 0) as discountTotal, 0 as refundAmount from biz_order o where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by o.cashier_by order by saleAmount desc limit #{limit}
choose.otherwise: select '' as dimensionKey, '' as dimensionName, 0 as saleAmount, 0 as orderCount, 0 as grossProfit, 0 as discountTotal, 0 as refundAmount from dual where 1 = 0
